_doc: Tags present in the SDK's docs/primitive-tags.json but NOT registered as custom elements at
runtime. Emitting one produces an HTMLUnknownElement: it renders nothing and throws nothing,
so neither a compiler nor a pixel diff can see it.
Captured by probing customElements.get() for all 441 registry tags against a RUNNING SDK.
The SDK's own capability audits do not check registration, so primitive-tags.json over-reports.
Re-capture after an SDK change: load the app, then in the console --

unregistered.snippyly-comment-pin: legacy vendor alias; never registered by the V2 tree
unregistered.velt-comment-dialog-body: container-shaped name with no registered element — was picked as an R2 anchor during the first primitives run and would have produced a silently dead thread card
unregistered.velt-comment-dialog-options: container-shaped name, not registered (the registered control is velt-comment-dialog-thread-card-options)
unregistered.velt-comment-sidebar-v2: SINGULAR; the registered host tag is velt-comments-sidebar-v2 (plural). The SDK's own React parity gate baselines this as a known false positive.
